title: Answer: experiments where invariant set theory and quantum theory differ

statements.text: Invariant set theory and standard quantum theory differ at identified points, which lead to noticeably different predictions. Experiments designed around them, the time-correlation test and the finite limit on entangled qubits among them, would show which of the two describes reality.

sources.quote: We identify points of difference between Invariant Set Theory and standard quantum theory, and show that these lead to noticeable differences in predictions between the two theories.
